recipe.name: Chamaeleo / Delft clay / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 001 through the sand master, z = 0 parting, opposed z withdrawal. The head is struck in profile on the parting line: every plate and tier crosses the line once and steps down away from it; the tail coils stand along the pull on the cheeks. After the pour: drill the eye on its raised mark, cut the seat to the measured alexandrite and burnish it flush. Polish the casque and the eye; leave the ground satin.
